description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the Order published under Sec. 5 of Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act No. 12 of 2006 by addition of new item immediately after item 33 w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is an order amending a previous order under the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006. It deals with regulatory changes to stamp duty requirements for credit card transactions and share certificates. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, specifically modifying financial regulations rather than government personnel or structural changes.
